figures.caption: Figure 1: Diagram of the proposed Hi-MoE. Experts are organized into hierarchical groups, promoting complementary specialization within groups and balanced, device-level utilization across groups during routing.

Figure 3: Group-level attention patterns of Swin Transformer with Hi-MoE on Tiny ImageNet. Different expert groups automatically specialize on distinct visual features: Group 1 (hands/rail), Group 2 (light-colored objects, e.g., white shirt), Group 3 (dark-colored objects, e.g. suit, surfaces behind human), Group 4 (body parts).
Figure 5: Expert activation heatmaps across all 12 MoE layers during nanoGPT-1B training. Subplots show different layers, with experts on the x-axis and training steps on the y-axis.
